Trigger: procs avoided trigger (ADR 0900): ten aggressive stationary strikers (creature 36) melee the caster, each carrying Self Root Forever 42716, Molten 62531 and Enrage 2116852, so 500 ms attempts, whose dodge and parry are set to 50% and 50% before every swing interval, so no swing lands and every attempt is an avoided attack (the trial). Sized as the Witch Hunter Dawn Knight (damage avoided) entry: residual_target 0.001 per pair, min_detectable 4 points (20% of 20: 10% equals the 2-point band, which leaves no room for an interval, procs.py residual_sizing). Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) reads "Avoiding an attack now has a 20% chance to grant you Angelic Presence ... within 15 seconds" (agrees); coa-history spell 800722: 166 applications, 68 refreshes and 173 removals in 5 to 7 logs, no per-attack roll visible; spell 92137 itself 0 events (a passive).

procs.proc_spell_source: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:336-338: an effective direct heal of Radiant Cascade rolls the ProcChance of 704920 (20) and casts 301293 on the caster
procs.handler: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:135 (check: healing && direct && Any(info, {500141, 500143})) and :336-338 (roll and cast). The trials are the heals of the trigger on the ally only (spell_heal_count, target ally): the ally is set to 1 health of a 2000000000 maximum before every cast, so each of its heals is effective and rolls; the caster stays at full health, so a chained heal of it is not effective and does not roll (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:51 and :135 take GetEffectiveHeal()), and the overheal on the ally and the effective healing on the caster are read at the end of each part and must be 0, else unmeasured. Radiant Cascade 500141 EffectChainTarget[0] 4 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_CHAINHEAL_ALLY): at most the ally and the caster in this setup. Residual: residual_target 0.001 with min_detectable 4 points, twice the 2-point band (ADR 0781), so at the minimum of 19386 trials both the false alert at the chance and the false pass of a 4-point deviation are at most 0.1% per pair (normal approximation); 188 parts schedule 29140 trials. Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.name: Bless (mana per tick)
behaviours.quote: and 5% of your maximum mana every 10 sec for 5 min.
behaviours.observe_source: Bless 804247 costs ManaCostPercentage 20 of BaseMana 1363 (player_class_stats class 27 level 60) = 272, instant; Effect[0] aura 227 every 10000 ms triggers 805360, whose Effect[0] BasePoints 4 with DieSides 1 gives 5 (spell_dbc 805360 EffectBasePoints_2 = 4, rev_20261121_01_sun_cleric_bless_mana_five_percent.sql, owner ruling O-4); AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:220-226 adds CalculatePct(max mana, Amount(805360,1)) on the caster's own tick. Maximum mana read with the max_power metric: 2868, so one tick is 5% of 2868 = 143 (143.4 truncated). Mana is set to 1363 at the start of both phases (phase_power with phase_power_in_uncast_before) with regeneration off. Control phase: Bless is known but not cast, the mana reads 1363. Treatment phase: Bless is cast on the caster and read 10500 ms later (one tick): 1363 - 272 (cost) + 143 = 1234. The expected value comes from the tooltip percent, the DBC mana cost percent and the maximum mana, not from a run. A tick of 1%, 2%, 4% or 6% reads 1119, 1148, 1205 or 1263 and is excluded (exact read, tolerance 1e-5). The 300357 doubling is measured by mana_tick_lead. Reference search: coa-history spell 804247 (347 casts in 27 logs) and 805360 (5324 heal and 2930 energize events in 30 and 12 logs, mean 871 and 974); bindmysoul 804247 reads "Bless an ally, restoring 5% of their maximum health every 10 sec for 5 minutes" (no self cast and no mana, an older state, G-9); owner ruling O-4 (2026-11-21) sets the mana to 5% of the maximum per tick, Sun Cleric ADR 0002. Nothing found that gives a live per tick mana percent beyond the ruling.

behaviours.name: Bless (self tick mana logged as Bless 805360)
behaviours.quote: and 5% of your maximum mana every 10 sec for 5 min.
behaviours.observe_source: Sun Cleric ADR 0020: the caster's own Bless tick (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:219-225, target == player) restores CalculatePct(maximum mana, Amount(805360, 1)) through Mana() with source 805360 (Bless, Effect[1] ENERGIZE_PCT BasePoints 4 + 1 = 5, AttributesEx SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT). Same scenario as mana_tick (Bless 804247 cast on the caster, regeneration off, read 10500 ms later after one 10000 ms period). The energize events of 805360 are summed: 0 in the uncast before phase (control, no Bless), and 5% of the reference maximum mana 2868 = 143.4, truncated to 143 (the same 143 mana_tick reads as 1234 - (1363 - 272)). Live: 805360 has 2930 SPELL_ENERGIZE events in 12 logs from 4 players (2026-08-17..2026-08-31, D-100 sweep).

The player route: Horusath Blast 500154 with 704908 known applies the marker 803238, the harness cast of Sunflare 800231 goes through HandleCastSpellOpcode like a client cast, where GetCastReplacement turns it into Sun Ray 504764 (SpellHandler.cpp:410-418), and the aura 807059 on the caster is read 6500 ms later: expected 1 from the Sun Ray tooltip and Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 807059 (DurationIndex 1, 10000 ms). behaviours.name: Mercy (grouped allies receive it)
behaviours.quote: Grant mercy to an ally and up to 5 nearby allies,

arms.source: Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget 6, MaxAffectedTargets 6: the four other grouped allies are nearby allies of the target, each holds Mercy; none holds it in the uncast control
arms.reach_source: The unit filter of the chain search is TARGET_CHECK_ALLY: WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck keeps a unit when _IsValidAssistTarget holds, with no IsInPartyWith or IsInRaidWith test (Spell.cpp:9353-9358, reached through WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck with the Chain reason, :9420-9479, which adds only a distance test; only TARGET_CHECK_PARTY :9359 and TARGET_CHECK_RAID :9373 test the group), so ally5 in raid subgroup 2 stands within the 10 yd hop like the party members. Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405)

behaviours.observe_source: 504848 Mercy Effect[0] aura 23 periodic trigger of 503650, target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget[0] 6, MaxAffectedTargets 6 (the target and up to 5 nearby allies). Reach: Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405). Mercy is cast at the grouped ally with four more allies grouped beside it (grouped allies are capped at 5); the Mercy aura is read on the target and, in one arm, summed over the four others: 0 in the uncast control, 1 on the target and 4 across the others after the cast. The cap of 5 nearby allies needs a seventh candidate and is not reachable with 5 grouped allies and the caster (tool need returned). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value; nothing found.

behaviours.name: Solemn Priest (Gavel of Light heals twice as much)
behaviours.quote: and causes Gavel of Light to heal you for an additional $s2% of its damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Light 800611 hits the dummy and the server copies a share of its damage to the caster as 707522 (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:283-290): the share is the effect value of the passive 707521, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($707521s1, 'heal yourself equal to $707521s1% of the damage dealt'). Solemn Priest 804269 Effect[1] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s2) on the class mask of 707521 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152): 'an additional 50% of its damage dealt', so 100% of the damage with the passive against 50% without. Both phases cast one Gavel of Light at the dummy with the caster at 50% health and +20000 attack power (a harness fixture) so that the hit is the same to 0.6% from one cast to the next (the weapon damage of 35 to 55 is lost against about 3400 of attack power (20000 / 14 x 2.4)); the first run, as a hit_ratio of the heals, could not read a heal on the caster (a hit_ratio reads the heals on the target of the cast). spell_heal_total sums every matching heal event since the scenario started (the leech_ratio note), so the after reading carries the before heal: (H + 2H) / H = 3.0, tolerance 0.15 (the 5-point band on +100%). Both phases carry the class tuning aura 887015 (-20% healing done) alike. Control: the phase without the passive. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul has no Solemn Priest entry (advancement.tsv lists the name only); coa-history spell 804269: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Fixture 984954 ('Reg’s Test Aura') carries Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT, BasePoints 100 (+101% weapon crit), so every Gavel hit (800611, DmgClass 2, melee) is a critical strike in both phases; the heal is a share of the damage dealt, so the ratio of the two phases is unaffected.

behaviours.name: Fanaticism (Gavel of Light mana cost)
behaviours.quote: and reduces their mana cost by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 805628 Fanaticism Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20%, Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask word index 1 (the second word) = 96, SpellFamilyFlags[1] bits 32 and 64 (Gavels, Horusath Blast). The caster's mana is set to 1000 before each cast (regeneration off) and read after a real cast of Gavel of Light 800611: ManaCost 3 + ManaCostPercentage 5 of base mana 1363 = 3 + 68 = 71, 1000 - 71 = 929 without the passive; -20% gives int(71 x 0.8) = 56, so 944 left. Gavel of Grace 800614 has ManaCost 0 and no ManaCostPercentage in the DBC, so there is no cost to reduce and no cost entry for it (the three Gavels differ in shape: Light and Wrath have a cost, Grace has none). Control = the phase before the learn (full cost). Tolerance 1 for the engine's integer truncation of the cost (CalculatePct, then ApplySpellMod on the int cost); a cost cut of 10% or 30% reads 8 or more off (int(71 x 0.9) = 63 and int(71 x 0.7) = 49). Reference search: coa-history spell 805628 and the three Gavel roots 800611, 800614, 800617: 0 events (the passive and the roots are not logged); the rank spells Gavel of Wrath 802561 (677 SPELL_DAMAGE, mean 568, 203 crits, 4 logs) and 802560 (13), Gavel of Light 502467 (2) carry no talent attribution, so they cannot settle the effectiveness; git log origin/main --grep and gh pr list --search (805628, Fanaticism, Gavel of Light, Gavel of Grace, Gavel of Wrath): merged PR #4516 (scenario sun-cleric-fanaticism: Player::ApplySpellMod reads 1000 back as 1200 and 1000 as 800, data level, no Gavel hit measured), PRs #8988 and #9558 (Gavel dodge and extra strikes, no effectiveness figure); the community snapshots carry the tooltip with no effectiveness figure (guide section 4).

behaviours.expected_source: 704938 Vindicator: Effect[0] ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 12 on class mask word 2 bit 1048576 (Glorious Execution), BasePoints -11; the server rewrites it to SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT, BasePoints 9 (+1 = 10, $s1), mask (0, 4096, 4), kept at 0 unless Vow of the Valkyr 807749 is on the caster (AscensionSunClericRadiance.cpp:45-53, :81-88). Glorious Execution 803913 (maximum rank) is cast and its main-hand strike 800691 (Effect[0] of 803913 triggers it; the cast itself logs no damage, the first run counted 0 hits) is observed on the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, armor) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value), so the dummy's armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000) in both. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant, as the Witch Hunter Stake entry). Treatment arm: Vindicator learned and Vow of the Valkyr 807749 on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject); control arm: Vow active, Vindicator not learned. Ignoring 10% of 5528 armor leaves 4975.2: the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / (4975.2 + 5500) = 1.0528 (+5.28%). The band is that of the stated 10% (G-19: the larger of 5% of it and 2 points, 8% to 12%), mapped through the same formula: 8% gives (5528 + 5500) / (5085.76 + 5500) = 1.0418 (+4.18%) and 12% gives (5528 + 5500) / (4864.64 + 5500) = 1.0640 (+6.40%), so the judged band is +-1.1 points on +5.28% (band_points 1.1, the smaller side), and a server ignoring 5% (+2.57%) or 15% (+8.13%) lies outside it. The 99% half-width at 498 trials per arm was 0.87 points (prove1, 3 parts of 166), so about 1930 trials per arm give the 0.44 the pilot sizes to: 12 parts of 166. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries the sentence ("ignores -10%", the sign an export artefact); coa-history spell 704938: 0 events in 186 logs, 803913 Glorious Execution 929 casts in 6 logs, no armor figure; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Sizing (batch 4): the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds half the band. Base pairs of this batch (20261122-012954 / -013141) read it not judged at the previous part count (12 parts); the judge's own sized_trials (the count whose half-width is 0.8 of the limit) was 1998 per arm, so the entry now runs 22 parts, at least 1.1 times that count. Residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair: the sample half-width has a relative standard deviation of about 2% at these counts and sits at 0.76 of the limit, 12 standard deviations below it, below 1e-9; a true bonus at the stated value cannot be read outside the band at this size either.

behaviours.expected_source: Accepted model of ADR sun-cleric 0008 (mentor D-61 and D-68): the expectation is the engine arithmetic enumerated over every random roll, float32 where the code uses float, from data and stat reads only, never from a measured bonus. 805628 Fanaticism Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% and Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask word index 1 = 96 (Gavels, Horusath Blast). The effectiveness figure is not in the tooltip; it is Effect[0] of the DBC, +20%, applied to integer values. Gavel of Wrath 800617: mean non-critical hit 141.4576 without the passive and 179.8455 with it, ratio 1.27137, a bonus of +27.14%. Gavel arithmetic (Physical, Spell::EffectWeaponDmg, SpellEffects.cpp:4668-4756): weapon roll urand(uint32(min), uint32(max)) with item 2529 (two-handed, multiplier 3.3) and attack power 70, rolls 90..119; flat value BasePoints + irand(1, DieSides) from the DBC, scaled by the passive as int32(float(value) x 1.2f); the weapon percent 100 becomes 120 the same way; the loop adds the flat value to the roll before the percent, in DBC order, with ApplyPct truncating; dummy armor 528 (dummy_armor entry), tmp = x / (1 + x) with x = 528 / (85 x 60 + 400) and the hit uint32(ceil(damage x (1 - tmp))) (Unit.cpp:2550-2560). Control: passive not learned. Out-of-sample arm: entry effect_gavel_oos (attack power 280, target creature 603 armor 3750; prediction commit 95f8ff6c99 written before any arm, pair 20261122-024352 / -024635, predicted +25.37%, read +25.57 / +25.08); Not tested: another weapon, another level, spell power. The judged band is the G-19 band, the larger of 5% of the bonus and 2 points; it is not widened. Reference search: coa-history spell 805628 and the three Gavel roots 800611, 800614, 800617: 0 events (the passive and the roots are not logged); the rank spells Gavel of Wrath 802561 (677 SPELL_DAMAGE, mean 568, 203 crits, 4 logs) and 802560 (13), Gavel of Light 502467 (2) carry no talent attribution, so they cannot settle the effectiveness; git log origin/main --grep and gh pr list --search (805628, Fanaticism, Gavel of Light, Gavel of Grace, Gavel of Wrath): merged PR #4516 (scenario sun-cleric-fanaticism: Player::ApplySpellMod reads 1000 back as 1200 and 1000 as 800, data level, no Gavel hit measured), PRs #8988 and #9558 (Gavel dodge and extra strikes, no effectiveness figure); the community snapshots carry the tooltip with no effectiveness figure (guide section 4). Sizing: the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds its limit. The counted pair 20261122-013639 / -013852 ran 800 trials per arm at 0.972 and 0.943 of the limit and sized 1182 and 1113 trials per arm; the entry now runs 14 parts, 1400 trials per arm, at least 1.1 times the larger sized count (1182). At 1400 trials the half-width is at most 0.735 of the limit (the worse run scaled by the square root of the trial ratio). Residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair: the half-width's relative standard deviation is 1 / sqrt(2 x trials) = 1.89%, and the limit lies 36% above it, 19 standard deviations, below 1e-9.

behaviours.name: Holy Form (extra heal on the ally affected by Bless, mana gate)
behaviours.quote: While at or above 30% mana, you sacrifice additional mana with each heal, healing your ally affected by Bless.

arms.source: cumulative count: one Daybreak heal on the blessed ally per phase, so 1 after the before phase and 2 after the after phase; the same cast lands in both phases, so a missing extra heal is not a missing Daybreak

behaviours.observe_source: 805301 Holy Form Effect[1] aura 4 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (BasePoints 49, $s2 = 50); AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:355-372: a heal with Holy Form on, at least 30% of maximum mana (:356-357), a non-zero effective heal (healing = Spell::m_healing, Spell.cpp:2856-2862, :3059) and the ally recorded by Bless alive and holding Bless (:358-359) pays (extra + 3) / 4 mana and casts 807994 on that ally (Copy(player, ally, 807994, extra), :370). In both phases the ally is set to 5000 of 10000 health, the caster's mana is set to the phase value, Bless 804247 is cast at the ally and Holy Form 805301 on the caster (setup casts, 2000 ms after each, past the global cooldown), then Daybreak 503624 heals the ally. Mana costs from Spell.dbc, ManaCostPercentage of base mana 1363, truncated by CalculatePct: Bless 20% = 272, Holy Form 40% = 545, Daybreak 26% = 354, taken before the heal (Spell::TakePower before SendSpellGo, Spell.cpp:4026), total 1171. The mana at the hook is the phase value minus 1171: 2021 gives 850 and 2043 gives 872, against a gate at 30% of the maximum mana 2868 (BaseMana 1363 + 20 + (Intellect 119 - 20) x 15) = 860.4, so 850 is 29.6% (below, no extra heal) and 872 is 30.4% (above, one extra heal). behaviours.name: Solar Nova (guaranteed critical strike on an Undead, entry 1501 Mindless Zombie)
behaviours.quote: This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:210-212 (OnSpellCritChance): a Solar Nova (named 680621, every rank) cast at a target of creature type Undead or Demon sets the crit chance to 100. The check counts the critical Solar Nova 681433 hits on the dummy (spell_damage_count, critical filter): 0 before (no cast), 1 after one cast. Fixture 984954 on the caster (DBC: Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT +100, inert for this magic-class spell; Effect[1] aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE, -1001, a precondition fixture, never the subject) removes the natural crit chance, so any crit comes from the guarantee, and the Humanoid control crit_control reads 0 crits with its hit landed. A spell hit against a target 3 or more levels below the caster cannot miss in the core, and a miss would read 0 here (an alert, never a pass). Residual false pass: none, the natural crit chance is removed and the control shows it. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 681433: 271 SPELL_DAMAGE events (67 crits) in 3 logs, no target creature type in the index; the sidekick, bindmysoul and ascension-data snapshots carry the tooltip sentence only: nothing found beyond the DBC, the tooltip and the script. creature_template.type of entry 1501 is 6 Undead (data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql).

behaviours.name: Pendant of the Sun (refreshes all Dawn charges)
behaviours.quote: Activate your pendant of the sun, refreshing the duration and all charges of Dawn.
behaviours.observe_source: 680630 Pendant of the Sun (RecoveryTime 60000, CasterAuraSpell 807440 so it needs Dawn) runs the class code AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:466-470: aura->SetCharges(aura->CalcMaxCharges()) and SetDuration(GetMaxDuration()) on the Dawn state aura 807440 (ProcCharges 10, DurationIndex 3 = 60000 ms). The Dawn state aura 807440 is set on the caster by the harness at the start of each phase (phase_auras) (a precondition fixture, the condition Pendant needs, not the subject); the setup casts of Illumination 500143 (a direct heal on the caster at 50% health) run in both phases, before the first reading, and the trigger cast is made in the after phase only. Each of the two heals expends one charge by the Dawn tooltip ('Each damaging or healing spell will expend a charge'): 10 - 2 = 8 charges, read before Pendant (the control reading of the same scenario: no Pendant cast, charges stay spent). Pendant is then cast and the charges are read 500 ms later: 10 with the refresh. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 680630 shows 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul and merged-PR search give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value.

behaviours.name: Arbiter of Grace (Glorious Execution mana while Vow of Grace is active)
behaviours.quote: While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional $807446s3% mana equal to the damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: 301313 Arbiter of Grace Effect[0] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), Spell.dbc BasePoints -1, set to 14 (+1 = 15) by AscensionSunClericValkyrie.cpp:25-26, class mask word 1 = 1024 = Glorious Execution Mana Passive 807451 SpellFamilyFlags[1]; 807451 Effect[0] BasePoints 4 (+1 = 5, the base 5% of the damage dealt) is the base percent. The class code (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp, OnSpellHitResult) restores CalculatePct(dealt, Amount(807451) + Amount(807446, 2)) as 807552 for Glorious Execution 800691 and 802566 while the caster has 301313 and the Vow of Grace aura 803719, and CalculatePct(dealt, Amount(807451)) otherwise; both reads are made without a caster, so 301313's own SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 never reaches them (Sun Cleric ADR 0018, mentor D-84). Vow of Grace 807446 Effect[2] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 BasePoints 14 (+1 = 15, $807446s3), class mask word 2 = 16777216 = Arbiter's own SpellFamilyFlags[2]. Glorious Execution 803913 is cast at the dummy in both phases with +20000 attack power and every hit forced critical (984954) so the damage is the same to well under 1%; the energize events of 807552 are totalled. The totals are cumulative over the scenario: the first reading is X (the first phase, 5% of the damage, no 301313), the second adds the second phase's events, so the stated ratio is (X + 20%/5% X) / X = 5.0 when the passive adds 15 points to 5, and 2.0 when it adds nothing. The 15-point claim has a band of 2 points (the larger of 5% of 15 and 2), 0.4 on that ratio (2/5), so 5.0 +- 0.4 excludes 4.4 and 5.6 and the 2.0 of no additional mana. Control: the first phase without 301313. Vow of Grace 803719 is cast on the caster before each phase (setup_casts); the arm without it is the entry ge_mana_no_vow. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries 'While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional 15% mana equal to the damage dealt.' (same figure); merged PR #4516 (#1818) set 301313's BasePoints and asserted 807451's modified value only, which no mana restore read (b6b review report I-1); coa-history shows Glorious Execution mana at 4.77% to 4.97% of its damage across 16 player/log pairs, and Arbiter of Grace, a passive, has no event there, so the logs neither confirm nor refute the 15%.

behaviours.name: Solar Champion (Horusath Blast cast at 38.5 yd)
behaviours.quote: Increases the range of your Piety spells by $s1%
behaviours.observe_source: 504734 Solar Champion (server DBC set) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% ($s1) and Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 2 (SPELLMOD_THREAT) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask [134217728, 17302850, 0], which Horusath Blast 500154 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 64) and Dawnsear 554406 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 2) carry. Horusath Blast 500154 is instant with RangeIndex 4 = 30 yd (SpellRange.dbc 4 RangeMax 30). Spell::CheckRange adds both units' combat reach to the maximum range (Unit::IsWithinCombatRange; the dummy entry 36 reads 1.275 yd, run 20261112-053731; the player reach is assumed at DEFAULT_COMBAT_REACH 1.5, ObjectDefines.h:45), so the boundary is 30 + 2.775 = 32.775 yd without the talent and 36 + 2.775 = 38.775 yd with it. Horusath Blast is cast at the dummy placed by dummy_distance; its own cast_failure is read; 97 is SPELL_FAILED_OUT_OF_RANGE (SharedDefines.h:1147). Before: talent not learned; after: 504734 learned. This entry: the dummy 38.5 yd away, inside 38.775: refused without the talent (97, past 32.775) and cast with it (0), so the effective range is at least 38.5 - 2.775 = 35.725 yd, a bonus of at least +19.1%, which excludes the claim's -10% (+18% = 35.4 yd gives a boundary of 38.175, short of 38.5). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 504734: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); sidekick snapshot carries the tooltip with no figure beyond it; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Solar Champion (threat generated, Dawnsear)
behaviours.quote: and reduces the threat generated by them by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 504734 Solar Champion (server DBC set) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% ($s1) and Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 2 (SPELLMOD_THREAT) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask [134217728, 17302850, 0], which Horusath Blast 500154 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 64) and Dawnsear 554406 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 2) carry. Dawnsear 554406 cast at the dummy at spell power 10000, once, after 504734 is learned. Threat of one hit = damage x (1 + SPELLMOD_THREAT) (ThreatManager.cpp:713 applies the mod to the damage threat) plus the flat initial threat of the cast, the spell level 60, added with ignoreModifiers true (Spell.cpp:5737, 5765; Holy Form 805301 threat entries, pair 20261120-221023 / -221237). Damage mean 708.5 + 10000 x 0.765222 = 8360.7 (Dawnsear Description ${$m1+0+$spfi*0.765222}): control 1 + 60 / 8360.7 = 1.00718, with the talent 0.8 + 60 / 8360.7 = 0.80718. A threat cut of 10% or 30% reads 0.1 off; tolerance 0.01. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 504734: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event); sidekick snapshot carries the tooltip with no figure beyond it; nothing else found. The metric is cumulative (the dummy's threat over the damage it has taken since the scenario began), so the control and the treatment are two entries, each reading one phase cleanly: threat_base casts Dawnsear before and after an unrelated passive (807963, Radiant Cascade only) is learned and must read the full-threat ratio both times; threat casts Dawnsear once, after 504734 is learned (cast_in_before false, so the 'before' read is 0).

Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed) delays a cast per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. Four Sunflare 800231 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms) at the dummy in one scenario, as the Necromancer Lich Essence entry: unhit and hit once by the striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 1000 ms into the cast without the passive, then the passive learned (a real learn) and again unhit and hit; every cast start, strike and casting poll is stamped with game_time_ms. Reduction = 1 - (reduced hit end - reduced unhit end) / (hit end - unhit end), judged in the G-19 band around 50; the pushback delay is 500 ms, so the reduced hit ends about 250 ms after the unhit one (windows 2190..2240 against 1940..1990). behaviours.name: March of the Valkyr group stack cap
behaviours.quote: Does not stack with similar effects.
behaviours.observe_source: data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260922_27_raid_damage_percent_group.sql spell_group 2000184, stack_rule 3 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_SAME_EFFECT) lists 300929 alongside 300944/300961/300963/503738/520371/560528/560534/560545, all SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) at effect index 0, Effect=65 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID), EffectMiscValue[0]=127 (all schools); this is the area-aura effect SpellMgr::IsEffectInSameEffectStackGroup admits into the group (SpellMgr.cpp:814-819). 300929 EffectBasePoints[0]=2 (3%), 300944 EffectBasePoints[0]=2 (3%, confirmed via DBC); 300929's other effect (index 1, spell-cost reduction, a different stat) does not touch melee_damage_done. Stock Unit::GetHighestExclusiveSameEffectSpellGroupValue (Unit.cpp:5297-5320) caps same-group same-effect auras at the single highest magnitude rather than summing them; no CoA script overrides this for either spell. The metric is spell_damage_done against Fireball (133, Fire school, SchoolMask 4), not melee_damage_done: Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:11470) explicitly skips GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE) whenever the queried damageSchoolMask includes SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL ('mods for SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL are already factored in base melee damage calculation', a different code path this synthetic base-1000 query never reaches), so a melee_damage_done read against this aura always comes back unchanged regardless of whether the server is conformant -- confirmed by an exploratory run with melee_damage_done that measured baseline==own==combined even after the area-aura wait below, which this change replaced with a Fire-school spell_damage_done read that does take the GetTotalAuraMultiplier branch. Verified via two independent gameplay runs of conformance-templar-behaviour-300929: spell_damage_done against a dummy with spell 133 (base 1000) read baseline, then (after a 300 ms wait for the area aura's own Aura::UpdateOwner target-map rescan, SpellAuras.cpp, to reach the caster) after learning 300929 alone, then after additionally learning 300944 (a Death Knight talent, learned onto the Templar fixture purely as test harness setup via the 'learn' action's unconditional player->learnSpell, not a production change); the combined reading matched the 3% single-effect cap, not a summed 6%, in both runs.

Glorious Execution 803913 is cast and its main-hand strike 800691 (Physical, SchoolMask 1) is read in a control arm and an arm with 802935 learned: the mean hit ratio is 1.06 (band 2 points, G-19: the larger of 5% of 6 and 2 points). Sizing (round 3): base pair 8 read +5.897% and +4.243% at 3 parts of 100 trials (300 per arm), a 99% half-width of 1.09 and 1.07 points, above the 1 point (half the 2-point band) the judge requires. The half-width falls with the square root of the trials, so 8 parts of 100 trials (800 per arm) were planned (about 0.66 points); the prove runner's pilot sized the pair to 8 parts of 166 trials (1328 per arm), which read half-widths of 0.518 and 0.517 points and standard errors of about 0.20 points, with the band edges 3.5 and 3.0 points (about 17 and 15 standard errors) from the reads, so the residual failure probability of a pair is far below the 0.1% limit. The sizing uses only the measured spread of base pair 8, never its mean as an expected value.

behaviours.name: Purgation (Holy damage taken at 8 stacks)
behaviours.quote: increases the target's Holy and Fire damage taken from you by $806025s1%
behaviours.expected_source: 806024 Purgation Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 806025 (Purgation debuff); the class code casts 806025 on the target of every own damage hit of Radiant Flame 807058 (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:116, :316). 806025 Effect[0] aura 271 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER MiscValue 6 (Holy 2 + Fire 4), BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1 ($806025s1), DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms, $806025d), StackAmount 8 ($806025U). Radiant Flame 806060 lasts DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms with EffectAmplitude 1000, so one cast ticks 807058 five times (SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, an extra tick on apply). Eight stacks of 1% = +8% (band 2 points, G-19: the larger of 5% of 8 and 2 points; the interval excludes the control 1.0 and a 2% or 0.5% per stack aura). Holy damage: Horusath Blast 500154 (SchoolMask 2 Holy) is read per arm after six Radiant Flame casts at about 1.5 s intervals (at least nine ticks, the stack cap is 8). Fixtures: spell penetration 823764 on the caster (precondition fixture, never the subject); Radiant Flame 806060 is cast for real six times before every observed cast in both arms (the real Purgation stacks are the subject, no set_aura of 806025); the control arm makes the same six casts without 806024 learned. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 806025 (the Purgation debuff): 221 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED, 825 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED_DOSE, 352 SPELL_AURA_REFRESH and 221 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED in 5 of 186 logs, no amount or stack figure in them; 806024 itself: 0 events (a passive); the bindmysoul talents snapshot in ~/CoaServer/reference lists the name only; nothing else found. Sizing (round 3): base pair 8 ran 10 trials per arm (9 treatment hits in the second run) and read +7.679% with a 99% half-width of 1.07 points, above the 1 point (half the 2-point band) the judge requires; the first run passed it. 20 trials per arm are the most one scenario holds (the 30 trials first tried exceed the 23 allowed, MAX_SCENARIO_MS 600000). The scaled projection 1.07 x sqrt(9/18) = 0.76 points is not what the residual rests on (at 0.76 the chance of a half-width above 1 is about 3% per run); it rests on the measured half-widths of four 20-trial runs on two pairs (0.46, 0.43, 0.42 and 0.48), under normal theory with about 16 degrees of freedom a half-width above 1 is about 2e-8 per run, and the estimate edge lies about 11 standard errors away, so the residual failure probability of a pair is far below the 0.1% limit on the measured spread. The sizing uses only the spread of base pair 8 and the pilot, never a mean as an expected value.

behaviours.reach_source: the dummy entry 36 combat reach 1.275 yd (creature_model_info CombatReach of display 367, world DB; read 1.275 in the Templar 1161 aggro_redirect edge run 20261112-053731), added for a player-controlled caster against a non-player target (Spell.cpp:9434-9442); the caster's own size is not a term; the judge reads each reach again and refuses a layout that does not bracket the edge
behaviours.observe_source: 807870 Effect[0] aura 12 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN, TargetA 22 SRC_CASTER, TargetB 15 TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 14 = 8 yd ($a1, the tooltip resolves 8; SpellEffectInfo::CalcRadius, SpellInfo.cpp:624-639, no SPELLMOD_RADIUS here). Effective radius (guide section 5, G-29): the area search measures from the caster, centre to centre, against 8 yd + the player caster's leeway 2.66 yd (Spell.cpp:1388-1394 for TargetB 15; Object.cpp:1787-1808, LEEWAY_BONUS_RANGE for a run speed above LEEWAY_MIN_MOVE_SPEED 4.97, ObjectDefines.h:50-51, a standing player in run mode at 7.0 yd/s) + the dummy's combat reach 1.275 yd (Spell.cpp:9434-9442) = 11.935 yd, computed by the kind's leeway option from the engine rule and the caster's run speed rate read in the run (ADR 1020), not from a measured edge; earlier diagnostic reads (stunned at about 11.4 yd, not at 12.5 yd, Sun Cleric b7a review I4) agree. The leeway is this core's inherited rule, not evidence about the original server. The primary dummy stands 0.1 yd from the caster and the inside and outside dummies 0.5 yd either side of 11.935 yd. Control arm: the cast is refused before 807870 is learned (gate = cast spell, learned between the arms), no stun on any dummy; treatment: one cast after the learn (120 s cooldown, so one repeat), the stun read per dummy: on the primary and the inside dummy, not on the outside one. behaviours.name: Sun Down (attackers swing inside the scorched earth)
behaviours.quote: reduces the target's chance to hit by
behaviours.observe_source: Solar Flare 807175 Effect[0] aura 54 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE BasePoints -3 ($s1 = 3), DurationIndex 10000 ms ($d), applied every 3000 ms by the ground aura 572754 of Sun Down 572752 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, ground 9000 ms starting 4000 ms after the cast starts). Eight aggressive stationary attackers (Harvest Golem 36, class level) melee the caster; the control arm counts their swings and misses with no cast, the treatment arm recasts Sun Down every 8000 ms (reset_cooldown and set_power are named precondition fixtures, G-21 point 6) and counts after 13000 ms, once the aura from the caster is read on every attacker; the aura is read on every attacker at each cycle end. Expected: the miss share rises by 3 points (the stated 3% of the DBC amount, never from a run); the judge takes the 99% interval of the difference of the two shares against the band of 2 points (the larger of 5% of 3 and 2), a verdict needing a half-width of at most half the band, so a correct server fails by chance with probability under 1e-6 and one 3 points off is excluded. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 572752/572753/572754/807175: Sun Down in one log (2026-08-01, 7 casts, no combat-table data on the attackers' swings); the bindmysoul snapshot carries the same sentence; nothing else found.

Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 801215: 10475 SPELL_HEAL events in 17 logs, 2034 crits, no recipient order or count per cast can be read from them; nothing found that states the figure.

behaviours.name: Glorious Defender (Gavel of Wrath effectiveness)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of Gavels by $s1%.
behaviours.expected_source: Accepted model of ADR sun-cleric 0008 (stock engine order accepted by ADR 0007 decision (a)): the expectation is the engine arithmetic enumerated over every random roll, float32 where the code uses float, from data and stat reads only, never from a measured bonus. 680634 Glorious Defender Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 24 + 1 = +25% ($s1) on EffectSpellClassMask word index 1 = 32, the SpellFamilyFlags[1] of the three Gavels (800611, 800614, 800617). The factor 1.25 is applied to integer values, as for Fanaticism: the flat value BasePoints + irand(1, DieSides) becomes int32(float(value) x 1.25f) and the weapon percent 100 becomes int32(100 x 1.25f) = 125 (SpellInfo.cpp:531, :592; Player.cpp:10622, :10677). Weapon: the class file maps 680634 to the weapon set Seraphim (spell_weapon_sets), item 2524 in the main hand (one-handed, damage 34.61 to 55.4, normalized speed 2.4) and a shield 2129 in the off hand (no damage); with attack power 70 the weapon roll is urand(uint32(34.61 + 70 / 14 x 2.4), uint32(55.4 + 70 / 14 x 2.4)) = urand(46, 67) (Unit.cpp:3621; StatSystem.cpp:728, :767). The loop adds the flat value to the roll before the percent, in DBC order, with ApplyPct truncating (SpellEffects.cpp:4731-4743); dummy armor 528, tmp = x / (1 + x) with x = 528 / (85 x 60 + 400), hit = uint32(ceil(damage x (1 - tmp))) (Unit.cpp:2550-2560). The same enumeration (the b8a script, rewritten as .agents/plans/weapon-sets-fix/scratch/gavel_expect_entry.py with the Wrath flat value 44 + irand(1, 11), the Light flat value 11 + 1 and the Grace flat value 22 + irand(1, 4), each scaled by 1.25f, and the weapon percent 99 + 1) reproduces exactly the means this entry recorded for the previous Seraphim weapon, item 2027 (77.5833 and 110.303, 42.9167 and 56.75, 54.375 and 73.9583). Correction history: the first design of this entry used the Valkyr weapon by mistake; its pair (20261122-072116 / -072234) read the three bonuses outside the wrong expectation and the weapon set explains it. The expectation here is recomputed from the class-file weapon only and is judged in a new pair. Correction (owner ruling O-10): the Seraphim main hand became the Truncheon 2524, so the expectation was recomputed with the same method from its damage range; the earlier 2027 values were the figures of a weapon no scenario equips any more. Gavel of Wrath 800617: mean non-critical hit 97.6736 without the passive and 135.4008 with it, ratio 1.38626, a bonus of +38.63%: the factor compounds on the flat value and on the percent, so the bonus exceeds the +25% of the tooltip, as ADR 0007 states for Fanaticism. Control: passive not learned. The judged band is the G-19 band, the larger of 5% of the bonus and 2 points; it is not widened. Not tested: another weapon, another level, spell power, another attack power or armor. Sizing: the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds its limit. In the first pair prove's pilot sized 1184 trials per arm and the entry's 16 parts hold 2656 at the trial limit of 166 per part; the judged half-widths were 0.55 point against a limit of about 1.9 to 2.1 points. Residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair: the half-width's relative standard deviation is 1 / sqrt(2 x trials) = 1.4% or less and the limit lies more than 40 standard deviations above it, below 1e-9.
behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Wrath 800617 damage read in two arms of one scenario; the treatment arm learns 680634 first. Control arm: no passive. Reference search 2026-11-22: server DBC 680634; coa-history spell 680634: 0 events in 186 logs; ascension-data advancement.tsv lists Glorious Defender as a talent node by name only; bindmysoul snapshot carries the tooltip without a figure; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.name: Burning Heat (Radiant Flame casts with no mana)
behaviours.quote: Casting Horusath Blast is now guaranteed to transform your next Sunflare into Sun Ray.
behaviours.observe_source: Ledger clause 242 of 704908 ("Your next Radiant Flame has no mana cost"). Radiant Flame 806060 costs 340 mana, Sun Ray 504764 costs 6% of 1363 = 81. The caster's mana is set to 82 before each phase's casts (regeneration off): the before phase cannot pay 340 and casts 0 times; the after phase pays 81 for the Sun Ray, keeps 1, and Radiant Flame goes through (1 cast of 806060 by the caster) only if its cost is at most 1 mana: a cost of 2 or more fails, so a 90% reduction (34 mana), a 99% one (3 mana) and any other short of 100% are excluded. Scorch Marks is granted by a real Sun Ray 504764 cast (setup_casts, the harness learns Sun Ray), never by set_aura; 704908 is known throughout and the before phase, without the Sun Ray, is the control. The same shape as the Searing Light 806021 entries of the same pair family (Scorch Marks 807059 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD op 1 -51 (-50), Effect[1] op 19 -51 (-50), Effect[2] op 14 -101 (-100), class mask 134217728 = Radiant Flame 806060: DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, EffectAmplitude 1000, ManaCostPercentage 25 of base mana 1363 = 340). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 806060 Radiant Flame, 807058 and 504764 Sun Ray: 0 events in 186 logs; spell 807059 Scorch Marks: 296 applications and 296 removals in 7 logs, no value to read; bindmysoul 806021 and 804625 texts read the Scorch Marks sentence as ours ("no mana cost, ticks -50% faster, duration reduced by -50%"); nothing else found. behaviours.name: Scroll of Hope (Magic damage taken 30% less)
behaviours.quote: Read from a scroll of hope, reducing Magic damage taken by party and raid members within $a1 yds by $s1% for $d.
behaviours.observe_source: 680646 Scroll of Hope Effect[0] APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID TargetA 1 (caster), aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN MiscValue 126 (the six magic schools), BasePoints -31 (-30 percent, $s1), radius index 18 (15 yd, $a1), DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms, $d); Effect[1] APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 681383; 681383 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT BasePoints 14 (+1 = 15 percent, $681383s1) on the caster-side target. Code: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:78 accepts a received damaging hit while the aura's target is below 35% health and the aura's script value is unset, :288-290 sets the value and casts 681383 at the target (once per aura). The Scroll is cast for real in the after phase only (cast_in_before false; 680646 has a 300000 ms cooldown, reset before the cast); the before phase is the control: the same strike without the Scroll. Strikes come from the passive striker (creature 36, spell hit bonus 100) with Grave Coil 47632 (Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Shadow, BasePoints 599 + 1 die side = 600, DmgClass magic, one hit, no tick), 1600 ms after the Scroll. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 680646, 681383 and 47632: 0 events in 186 logs; ~/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/bindmysoul talents.normalized.json reads "reducing Magic damage taken by party and raid members within 15 yds by -30% for 10 seconds ... below 35% ... healed once for 15%" (agrees with the DBC); nothing else found. Reduction: the cumulative amount Grave Coil dealt to the caster is read after each phase, c in the before phase (no Scroll) and c + h after the Scroll (one more hit h). The control hit measured 605 and 606 in the counted pair, not the 600 of the DBC base; the extra 5 to 6 is not explained and its cause is not established. The verdict therefore judges the gain against the measured control hit, as the ratio (c + h) / c = 1 + h / c = 2 - r, expected 1.70 for r = 30% with tolerance 0.02 (the 2-point band of 28% to 32% is 1.68 to 1.72): a 33% reduction reads 1.67 and a 27% reduction 1.73, both outside, and a control hit below 600 fails the floor. Scope: Shadow only (Grave Coil is Shadow); MiscValue 126 covers the six schools, and no other school and no physical control is read here. Phase aura 823764 "beeg spellpen" (Effect[0] aura 123 MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, BasePoints -9999, MiscValue 126, DBC) is the class's standing resistance fixture, set on the caster in both phases: it lowers the resistance of what the caster hits, not the resistance the caster has against Grave Coil, so it does not touch the hits read here, and a resisted hit could only lower a reading.

arms.source: The caster at 99% health is the healthiest of the eight, so the five lowest (allies at about 50%, large pools that regeneration does not refill) are healed and the caster is not: 5 Sunlight heals in all, 0 on the caster (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:155-160 orders by health percentage).

behaviours.observe_source: 92136 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 704911; AscensionSunCleric.cpp:298-300 (Fulfill) heals with Sunlight 704911 the allies returned by Allies(player, player, Radius(704911), MaxAffectedTargets of 704911) (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:149-165): the caster and the units of the caster's raid within the radius, sorted by health percentage (lowest first, ties by GUID), cut to MaxAffectedTargets. 704911 MaxAffectedTargets = 5 ($704911i, the tooltip resolves 5 with the reference stats). Eight players stand in the raid (the caster and seven allies, ally_arm allies 7), all within the 40 yd radius, the seven allies set to 5000 of 10000 health (50%) in each phase, a pool that one out-of-combat regeneration tick (about 92 health per 2000 ms) cannot refill in the 3200 ms before Illumination, as in the 534267 cap entry. Dawn 804584 cast with 20 Solar Power 500149 set (harness precondition fixture), Vow of Radiance 803489 cast before it, Illumination 500143 (a direct heal) cast on the caster as in the heal entry; 92136 learned between the phases. Control (before): the same casts without 92136, no Sunlight heal. Heals are counted from the caster's own spell_heal_count of 704911, all targets. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 92136: 0 casts (a passive); no snapshot in ~/CoaServer/reference carries a target cap or an ordering beyond the tooltip; nothing found. The caster at 99% health is the healthiest of the eight, so the five lowest (allies at about 50%, large pools that regeneration does not refill) are healed and the caster is not: 5 Sunlight heals in all, 0 on the caster (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:155-160 orders by health percentage). Discrimination, stated: the seven allies hold the same percentage (about 50%), so the order shows only through the caster's health. Against a GUID order the check discriminates only if the caster's GUID is among the five lowest of the eight, which is not shown; against a random pick of five of eight both caster entries pass together with probability about (3/8 x 5/8)^2 = 5.5% per pair, not the 0.1% the rules ask. The priority wording therefore holds as the observed result of this layout, and a layout with spread health (some allies at 100%) would decide it alone.

arms.reach_source: The unit filter of the chain search is TARGET_CHECK_ALLY: WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck keeps a unit when _IsValidAssistTarget holds, with no IsInPartyWith or IsInRaidWith test (Spell.cpp:9353-9358, reached through WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck with the Chain reason, :9420-9479, which adds only a distance test; only TARGET_CHECK_PARTY :9359 and TARGET_CHECK_RAID :9373 test the group), so ally5 in raid subgroup 2 stands within the 10 yd hop like the party members. Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405)

behaviours.observe_source: 804257 Glaring Rays Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($s1), TargetA 1 (caster), radius index 287; Effect[1] APPLY_AURA aura 216, BasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($s2), TargetA 1. Holy Form 805301 is cast in both phases as the trigger and the passive is learned between them (control: the before reading without it, multiplier 1). The unit's engine cast speed multiplier (the same function as the Swift Justice 300327 spell_haste entry) is read 1500 ms after. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 804257: 0 events (a passive leaves no event); nothing else found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. The caster receives both effects. Each aura 216 multiplies the unit's cast speed: AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5035-5056) calls Unit::ApplyCastTimePercentMod (Unit.cpp:14991-14999) once per effect, and ApplyPercentModFloatVar multiplies by 100 / (100 + 3) (Unit.cpp:14967-14970), so the two effects give 1 / (1.03 x 1.03) = 0.942596, not the additive 1 / 1.06 = 0.943396 (pair 1 read 0.942596 in both runs; this expectation is the engine rule, written from the code before the re-run). The second effect applies only through the CoA raid group exception (SpellMgr.cpp:826-828, 4ced460235): Glaring Rays is in spell_group 2000182, which the stock rule (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5049-5051) would let block Effect[1]. Mentor ruling D-119 (2026-11-22): the second effect 'an additional $s2%' is its own aura 216, so the engine stacks the two multipliers: 1/1.03^2 for the caster, 1/1.03 for a party ally (ally_haste). The tooltip's additive reading, 1/1.06 = 0.943396, differs by 0.08%, eight times the tolerance of this band, which accepts only the engine value; the expectation is the engine rule with its cited lines, not the measured value.

behaviours.name: Blessing of Kings (Hammer of Kings cooldown after a critical Gavel of Wrath)
behaviours.quote: Critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Kings and Solar Prayer by $/1000;680671s1.

cast_auras.reason: 984954 makes every Gavel of Wrath hit a critical strike (weapon crit +101) and no spell crit, 823764 removes the dummy's resists; both are set on the caster before each Gavel cast, a precondition fixture, the claim is the cooldown reduction a critical hit applies.

behaviours.observe_source: 561327 Effect[1] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 680671; 680671 Effect[0] and Effect[1] are SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN (165) with EffectBasePoints -1001 and EffectMiscValue 804751 (Hammer of Kings) and 806479 (Solar Prayer): $/1000;680671s1 = 1 second. AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:117 gates 561327 on an own, non-derived critical damage or healing event and :324-326 calls Reduce(player, 804751, |Amount(680671)|) and Reduce(player, 806479, ...). Route: the cooldown cost_gate (guide section 2, Lorescribe), a cast attempt the server accepts or refuses, not a cooldown readback. Hammer of Kings 804751 (Spell.dbc RecoveryTime 20000) is cast on the caster as the priming cast, then Gavel of Wrath 802561 is cast at the dummy at 5 yd 1600 ms later; the critical-hit fixture 984954 (Effect[0] aura 52 weapon crit +101, Effect[1] aura 57 spell crit -1000) and 823764 (the dummy's resists removed) are set on the caster before that Gavel cast only (cast_auras), a precondition fixture: the claim is the cooldown reduction a real critical hit applies. Class file ratings (melee hit and expertise 10000) leave no miss, dodge or parry: the crit probability is 1 by construction, residual failure probability 0 per pair. The gate attempts the Hammer again 19060 ms after the priming cast (arm with, expected accepted; arm without, 561327 unknown, refused: the control) and 18940 ms after it (arm beyond, refused: the reduction is no larger than 1 s). margin_ms 60 puts the attempts 60 ms either side of the reduced cooldown, so a reduction of 900 ms (refused at the with attempt) and one of 1100 ms or two crits (accepted at the beyond attempt) alert: the 10% either side of the 1000 ms claim are excluded. Healing critical strikes are not run (see the ledger row). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 561327 and 680671: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive and its proc); Hammer of Kings 804751 377 aura applications in 6 logs and Solar Prayer 806479 41 casts in 17 logs carry no cooldown link; bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) reads 'Critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Kings and Solar Prayer by -1.' (tooltip figure, 1 second); nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Holy Knight (Gavel of Light additionally heals 5 of 6 nearby allies)
behaviours.quote: Your Gavel of Light now additionally heals up to 5 nearby allies
behaviours.observe_source: 301011 Effect[0] aura 354 ASCENSION_PROC_PERCENT_EVENT (BasePoints 99 +1 = 100, $s1), trigger 301012 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, TargetA 31 TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY, EffectRadiusIndex 9). AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:289-300: when the caster's own Gavel of Light heal 707522 (State.gavelHealing, set by the Gavel of Light 800611 branch at :326-335) lands on the caster with 301011 known, Allies(player, player, Radius(301012)) minus the caster is cut to 5 (allies.resize(5)) and each receives Copy(player, ally, 301012, CalculatePct(healing, Amount(301011))). Allies() keeps units in the caster's raid and friendly (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:149-157), so 6 grouped allies stand within range and the count read is the number of 301012 heal events the caster cast: 5. The count is read as the caster's spell_heal_count of 301012 (events the caster itself cast, any target), 0 in the before phase (control: 301011 not learned, Gavel of Light cast the same way) and 5 after the learn; the counter is cumulative and the before reading is 0, so the after reading is the gain. Gavel of Light 800611 at the dummy at 5 yd with the caster held at 50% health (so the self heal is not zero); 984954 makes the Gavel hit a critical strike in both phases, 823764 removes resists; class file ratings leave no miss: residual failure probability 0 per pair. Weapon set Blessings (spell_weapon_sets 301011). The amount (100% of the self heal) is not read here (see the ledger row). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 301012 Holy Knight: SPELL_HEAL 714 events in 4 logs (mean 949); 301011: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); ascension-data advancement rows carry the acquisition only. The independent review of this batch (.agents/plans/sun-cleric-b8d-review/report.md, M5; not re-read here) found in one raid log (2026-08-22, 15 players, three fights) that each 707522 self heal is followed by 301012 heals in groups of 5 (69 of 73 groups, the others 3 or 4) and that each 301012 amount equals the 707522 amount (ratio 1.000 in 245 of 245 heals): both agree with the tooltip (up to 5 allies, 100% of the amount), and are not a measurement of ours.

behaviours.name: Glorious Execution (main-hand strike)
behaviours.quote: Strike with both weapons dealing Weapon Damage plus $s1 Physical damage
behaviours.observe_source: Tooltip 803913: 'Strike with both weapons dealing Weapon Damage plus $s1 Physical damage'; $s1 = 76 (803913 EffectBasePoints[0] 75 + 1, EffectDieSides 1), passed to each hand's strike by SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (803913 Effect[0] 142 -> 800691 main hand, Effect[2] 142 -> 802566 off hand). Each strike is one SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (121), SchoolMask 1 (Physical). Model part normalized_value (ADR 0762): the hand's weapon roll (Valkyr set, two 2529 Zweihander 73.62 to 103.34, 2800 ms, normalized speed 3.3, learned 707072 Titan's Grip) plus attack power / 14 x its normalized speed, times 0.5 for the off hand, plus the value points (halved and truncated on the off hand), then armor mitigation; the 99% interval of the mean of 40 non-critical hits is judged, and the control arm (no cast) must count 0 hits of 800691. The strikes 800691 and 802566 are mapped to the Valkyr weapon set in spell_weapon_sets so that the judged weapon is the one the scenario wears (the spell 803913 maps to Valkyr). Class file ratings leave no miss. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history 800691 SPELL_DAMAGE 3417 events in 14 logs (mean 731) and 802566 3362 events (mean 503). Per player (coa-history spell_events, SPELL_DAMAGE mean of 802566 over 800691, players with 20 or more hits of each) the off-hand to main-hand ratio is 227.0/354.8 = 0.64, 820.0/1266.6 = 0.65, 618.8/866.5 = 0.71, 342.1/432.6 = 0.79, 203.7/255.4 = 0.80 and 374.8/440.6 = 0.85 for six players (23 to 1406 hits each), against 0.50 here by model and measure (the engine's UNIT_MOD_DAMAGE_OFFHAND 0.5 on the weapon and the fixed bonus, SpellEffects.cpp:4689-4706, ADR 0762; the off hand measures plus 38 where the tooltip states 'plus $s1' for each strike). The live ratio is above ours for every player: a lead on the off-hand share, not an agreement and not a proven difference (live gear, off-hand talents and crits are unknown), held open for the owner; no value is taken from the live figures; bindmysoul has no Glorious Execution value; coabuildhub index lists the name only; nothing found for the flat 76 beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.observe_source: 804252 Blessing of Absolution Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15, the additional threat of the tooltip ('generating additional threat'; no number). CoA's Spell.dbc carries these effect 63 values as a percentage of the damage, which Ascension used and the server reproduces with a spell_threat row of pctMod 1 + 15 / 100 = 1.15 (data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20261026_20_coa_tank_ability_threat.sql, merged in PR #9382 for the other effect 63 spells; the High Threat ruling for Justicar's Wrath 806980 (threat x2) concerns another tooltip word and does not decide 'additional threat'; the flat effect 63 amount is kept). Threat of one hit is damage x 1.15 plus the flat effect amount 15, divided by the health the dummy lost: 1.15 + 15 / D. The cast is the 503505 cast at a Blessed ally (Bless 804247 cast at the ally in both phases), with 20000 spell power (fixture) so the Holy hit is 404..456 + int(1.5 x 20000) = 30404..30456 and the flat part moves the ratio by 0.0005 only: 1.1505. The band is 2 points of the 15 percent (G-19), 0.02: it excludes no additional threat (1.0, 1.0000 + the spell level 1 of 804252 over D) and a percentage of 13 or 17. The control of the claim is the threat_control entry of the same pair: an ordinary Holy hit reads about 1.0. Crit forced out by fixture 984954. Control (before): the same Bless without the 503505 cast, no damage and a ratio of 0. The tooltip gives no number: the qualitative claim 'additional threat' is proven by 1.1505 against the control 1.0056 (band 0.02); the 15 percent is the server convention (#9382), pinned here as a regression, not a ruling on the tooltip. Information for the mentor: the damage and the threat are credited to the Sun Cleric, not to the Blessed ally who 'unleashes' the burst. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 804252: 8 SPELL_DAMAGE events of 1015 in 1 log, no threat events are logged; the pending SQL above; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Solar Concord (Horusath Blast recast in Sunrise)
behaviours.quote: Resets the cooldown of Horusath Blast while in Sunrise and Rapture while in Sunset and causes their damage dealt to launch a Solar Flare.

cast_auras.reason: Sunrise 500477 and the Sunrise-or-Sunset checker 500643 (CasterAuraSpell of 301266) are set on the caster before the Solar Concord cast: named precondition fixtures; the claim measured is the cooldown reset the cast applies, not the phase condition.

behaviours.observe_source: 301266 Solar Concord: its aura apply handler (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:101-106) calls Reduce(player, 500154, INT32_MAX) in Sunrise and Reduce(player, 806477, INT32_MAX) in Sunset; the installed DBC also resets both cooldowns on every cast with no phase gate: Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 302899 and Effect[2] TRIGGER_SPELL 301268 (301268 Effect[0] 195 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN MiscValue 500154; 302899 Effect[0] 195 MiscValue 806477; neither has a CasterAuraSpell; handler SpellEffects.cpp:1103-1112). Horusath Blast has RecoveryTime 25000 ms. The cooldown cost_gate (resets) casts Horusath Blast as the priming cast, then Solar Concord 1600 ms later (the cast is made in the with arm only), then attempts Horusath Blast again 1600 ms after that (past the global cooldown of the Solar Concord cast), inside its 25000 ms cooldown: refused without the Solar Concord cast (the control, SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY), accepted with it. The accepted or refused cast is an event (cast_failure), not a cooldown readback. The without arm drops both the Solar Concord cast and the phase aura, so it proves the reset by the cast and not the words "while in Sunrise": that phase condition stays open (tool need: a cost_gate arm with the cast in the other phase, expected refused).
